series_break: ARCH-1 -> ARCH-2 is an explicit classification-series break. ESI-1 and CMS-1 remain unchanged.

authority.statement: ARCH-2 classifies ESI-1 symbols deterministically for architecture cleanup/ownership visibility. It never authorizes deletion by itself and cannot weaken build, test, Kodex or runtime gates.

A.label: Loeschbar
A.meaning: A private free function with productive_reachability=NO may be A only when it belongs to a closed unreachable removal component. Every lexical incoming reference to every member must originate from a member of the same component; cfg/export/test/bench/proc-macro/used-sensitive declarations are excluded.
A.fail_closed: Any reference from outside the component, any ownerless/global reference, sensitive declaration attribute, unresolved name or other missing prerequisite yields no A classification.

B.label: Zusammenfuehrbar / redundant
B.meaning: An explicitly legacy/obsolete/deprecated/shadow-named symbol that is itself still bound by reachability/reference evidence has a deterministic same-file counterpart target that is productively reachable or referenced.
B.fail_closed: No concrete target yields no B classification.

C.label: Notwendige Unterstuetzung
C.meaning: A symbol is productively reachable without an ARCH-2 D authority rule, or is explicitly bound test/tool support under the fixed rules. Being located in an authority- or gate-named module is not sufficient for D.

D.label: Autoritativer Kern
D.meaning: A productively reachable entrypoint or a symbol whose own simple name carries explicit Writer/Authorization, Selection, Canonical or Governance validate/verify responsibility matches an ARCH-2 D rule.
D.negative_rule: Module path, file path and enclosing namespace names alone never establish D in ARCH-2.

OFFEN.label: Nicht sicher entscheidbar
OFFEN.meaning: No A/B/C/D rule has sufficient static evidence. OFFEN is the mandatory fail-closed default.

removed_legacy_class: N is not part of ARCH-2. Legacy AIC-1 A/B/C/N/OFFEN classifications are not comparable to ARCH-1 or ARCH-2.

comparability.rule: A/B/C/D/OFFEN counts are directly comparable only when architecture_contract_version is identical. r987 ARCH-1 remains a historical baseline; the first green ARCH-2 inventory is the ARCH-2 baseline.

deletion_boundary: Class A is a static architecture statement inside ESI-1 scope, not a command to mutate source. Actual removal still requires normal EtuSchlopf change control and gates.
